# Detect AI Bots

Source: [1882](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1882); edited 2023-04-18. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-1882-n1"></a>

- Documented distinction: dummy bots are Workshop-created and inert by default; lobby AI bots are host-added and run AI.

<a id="wiki-1882-n2"></a>

- AI detection recipe first excludes Is Dummy Bot, temporarily forces a zero-width-character name invalid for real Battle.net users, compares the player's stringified name, records IsAIBot if it changed, then stops forcing the name.

<a id="wiki-1882-n3"></a>

- The recipe relies on name forcing affecting AI bots but not real players and restores names immediately.

Source limitations:

- April 2023 behavior relies on a side effect, not a dedicated AI predicate; verify against newer player-classification articles and current game.

- Temporary name mutation can interact with other naming logic; recipe only sets its flag true and does not explicitly initialize/reset it.
